name: reforge
description: Skills that redo your work as a tournament - rebuild it, sharpen it, redesign it, or put it on trial - scored and fought head-to-head, round after round.

plugins.name: reforge
plugins.description: Four skills that redo your work as a tournament: re-make rebuilds it from scratch, re-master sharpens it in place, re-design redesigns the interface, re-view puts it on trial with a panel of lenses. Every attempt is scored against a frozen rubric, fought head-to-head against the reigning champion, and reported with a round-by-round table.
